boards.name: LilyGO T-Dongle-S3
boards.statusIndicator: 0.96" color LCD + dim rear APA102 LED
boards.pcPortNote: Plug the USB-A plug directly into any PC, Mac, or Linux USB port.
bootInstructions: Hold the small BOOT button on the side of the dongle.
While still holding BOOT, plug the dongle into your computer's USB port.
Release BOOT after plugging it in, then click Connect & Flash below.
After flashing completes, unplug the dongle and plug it back in normally.
boards.notes: Recommended all-in-one USB stick with built-in status screen showing connection state, pairing timer, and device code.

boards.name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3
boards.usbConnector: USB-C (use a data-capable USB cable or USB-C to USB-A adapter)
boards.pcPortNote: Connect its USB-C port to your computer with a data-capable USB cable.
bootInstructions: Hold the tiny B (BOOT) button near the USB-C connector.
While holding B, connect the board to your computer using a USB data cable.
Release B once plugged in, then click Connect & Flash below.
After flashing, unplug and replug the board (or press R) without holding B.
boards.notes: Thumb-sized USB-C board. Has no screen, so status is shown by the onboard LED blink pattern.

boards.name: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N8 / N4 / Quad PSRAM)
boards.usbConnector: Dual USB-C (COM/UART for flashing, USB for HID)
boards.pcPortNote: Use the port labeled USB (not COM/UART) when plugging into the target computer as a mouse and keyboard.
bootInstructions: Plug a USB data cable into the port labeled COM or UART (no BOOT hold needed on most boards).
If flashing does not connect, hold BOOT, tap RST, then release BOOT.
After flashing finishes, move your USB cable to the port labeled USB to use it with your PC.
boards.notes: For standard N8/N4 modules without octal PSRAM. Use the N16R8 / N8R8 build if your module has octal PSRAM (R8).

boards.name: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N16R8 / N8R8 Octal PSRAM)
boards.usbConnector: Dual USB-C (COM/UART for flashing, USB for HID)
boards.pcPortNote: Use the port labeled USB (not COM/UART) when plugging into the target computer as a mouse and keyboard.
bootInstructions: Plug a USB data cable into the port labeled COM or UART (no BOOT hold needed on most boards).
If flashing over the USB port directly, hold BOOT while plugging in and replug after flashing.
To use as a dongle, plug the port labeled USB into your computer.
boards.notes: Configured with octal PSRAM (qio_opi) required by ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8 and N8R8 modules. RGB LED is on GPIO 48 (GPIO 38 on v1.1 boards).
